command:
set -eu
umask 077
install -d -m 0700 /etc/fleet-ca/private
install -d -m 0755 /etc/fleet-ca/certs
if [ ! -s /etc/fleet-ca/private/fleet-internal-ca.key ] || [ ! -s /etc/fleet-ca/certs/fleet-internal-ca.crt ]; then
  openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:3072 -sha256 -nodes \
    -keyout /etc/fleet-ca/private/fleet-internal-ca.key \
    -out /etc/fleet-ca/certs/fleet-internal-ca.crt \
    -days 3650 -subj '/CN=Fleet Internal CA' \
    -addext 'basicConstraints=critical,CA:true,pathlen:0' \
    -addext 'keyUsage=critical,keyCertSign,cRLSign' \
    -addext 'subjectKeyIdentifier=hash'
fi
chmod 0600 /etc/fleet-ca/private/fleet-internal-ca.key
chmod 0644 /etc/fleet-ca/certs/fleet-internal-ca.crt
install -m 0644 /etc/fleet-ca/certs/fleet-internal-ca.crt /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/fleet-internal-ca.crt
update-ca-certificates
openssl x509 -in /etc/fleet-ca/certs/fleet-internal-ca.crt -noout -subject -issuer -dates
openssl verify -CAfile /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt /etc/fleet-ca/certs/fleet-internal-ca.crt
